title: Tus Miv
blurb: A cat, a mouse, and a game only one of them is playing.

paragraphs.hmong: Tus miv haus mis hauv lub tais.
paragraphs.english: The cat drinks milk from a bowl.

paragraphs.hmong: Tus miv pom tus nas los.
paragraphs.english: The cat sees the mouse coming.

paragraphs.hmong: Tus miv xav tau tias tus nas xis noj heev.
paragraphs.english: The cat thinks that the mouse would be very tasty to eat.

paragraphs.hmong: Nws mus puag tim tus nas tawm tuaj.
paragraphs.english: It goes over toward where the mouse will come out.

paragraphs.hmong: Nws tos tus nas tiam sis tus nas twb paub tag lawm.
paragraphs.english: It waits for the mouse, but the mouse already knows everything.

paragraphs.hmong: Tus nas ua lub suab me’ li nws tawm los xwb.
paragraphs.english: The mouse makes a small sound as if it is coming out.

paragraphs.hmong: Tus nas twb to taub tus miv lub siab tas.
paragraphs.english: The mouse already understands the cat's intentions.

paragraphs.hmong: Tus nas lam sim tus miv lub siab kom nws muaj siab xwb.
paragraphs.english: The mouse is only testing the cat's patience, so that the cat stays eager.

paragraphs.hmong: Tus nas maj mam ua lub suab me’ li nws yuav tawm los tiag.
paragraphs.english: The mouse slowly makes a little sound, as if it really is about to come out.

paragraphs.hmong: Tus miv xav tias nws mas tau noj kiag tus nas.
paragraphs.english: The cat thinks it is about to eat the mouse.

paragraphs.hmong: Nws tos tus nas tau ob peb teev los tus nas kuj ua suab xuav’ kom tus miv muaj’ siab xwb.
paragraphs.english: It waits several hours, but the mouse keeps whistling only to keep the cat interested.

paragraphs.hmong: Tau peb teev lawm, tus miv mam paub tias tus nas ua si xwb.
paragraphs.english: After three hours, the cat finally realises that the mouse was only playing.

paragraphs.hmong: Tus miv ua ib siab li nws tu siab mus pw tib tug no’ ib leeg tim nws lub hoob.
paragraphs.english: The cat makes up its mind, feels sad, and goes to sleep alone in its room.

paragraphs.hmong: Tus nas pom tau tias tus miv mus pw lawm, nws mam tawm los xuav kauv ua si kom luab lim tus miv.
paragraphs.english: The mouse sees that the cat has gone to sleep, then comes out, whistling and playing to mock the cat.

paragraphs.hmong: Tus nas mas niam mus’ los’, haus miv tais mis, taug kev ua si tom tej ua li nws kaj siab heev.
paragraphs.english: The mouse goes back and forth, drinks the milk from the cat's bowl, and walks around playing; it feels very peaceful and happy.

paragraphs.hmong: Tib sij huam li ib laim muag, tus miv tib kaug ua tus nas poob siab kiag.
paragraphs.english: In the blink of an eye, the cat suddenly leaves the mouse terrified.

paragraphs.hmong: Tus nas mam paub tias tus miv los muab nws tom lawm.
paragraphs.english: The mouse then realises that the cat has come to bite it.

paragraphs.hmong: Tus nas mam xav tias paub li mas.
paragraphs.english: The mouse thinks, "I should have known."

glossary.english: to tease, to mock, to make fun of
to whistle; a whistling or hissing sound
in an instant; all at once; suddenly
suddenly; immediately; in one quick motion
"I should have known" — an expression of realisation or regret
like, as if — "li nws tawm los", as if it were coming out
inner intention, desire, resolve — literally the heart or liver
to make up one's mind; to steel oneself

questions.prompt: Tus miv haus dab tsi? — What is the cat drinking?
questions.because: Paragraph 1 — "Tus miv haus mis hauv lub tais."

questions.prompt: Vim li cas tus nas ua lub suab me? — Why does the mouse keep making a small sound?
options: To keep the cat eager and waiting
questions.answer: To keep the cat eager and waiting
questions.because: Paragraph 3 — "Tus nas lam sim tus miv lub siab kom nws muaj siab xwb."

questions.prompt: Tau pes tsawg teev tus miv mam paub tias tus nas ua si? — How long before the cat realises the mouse is only playing?
questions.because: Paragraph 4 — "Tau peb teev lawm, tus miv mam paub tias tus nas ua si xwb."

questions.prompt: Thaum tus miv mus pw lawm, tus nas ua dab tsi? — Once the cat has gone to sleep, what does the mouse do?
options: It comes out and drinks the cat's milk
It runs away from the house
It goes to sleep as well
questions.answer: It comes out and drinks the cat's milk
questions.because: Paragraph 6 — "…haus miv tais mis, taug kev ua si tom tej…"

questions.prompt: Thaum kawg, tus miv ua dab tsi rau tus nas? — In the end, what does the cat do to the mouse?
questions.because: Paragraph 6 — "Tus nas mam paub tias tus miv los muab nws tom lawm."
